t4_inflation_acpl_per_decade.verdict: An effect of 0.5 cp per decade would have fit inside this interval, so the null does NOT rule it out. The design cannot see effects this small.

t8_within_player_acpl_per_decade.verdict: An effect of 0.5 cp per decade would have fit inside this interval, so the null does NOT rule it out. The design cannot see effects this small.

t8_curvature_spec_resolution.note: Descriptive resolution bound, not an 80%-power MDE. An effect near this size sits at the edge of what the observed interval could distinguish from zero.

t2_opening_slope.note: residual sd=0.02857, sum of squared x deviations=0.04174, n=12
t2_opening_slope.why: The x-axis spans about 0.26 pawns across every mainline opening. Slope resolution depends on the spread of x as much as on sample size, which is why this null is weak no matter how many games are added.

t6_online_band_contrast.note: baseline p=0.187, n=94 per group, design effect 2.18x from clustering
t6_online_band_contrast.why: The observed spread across online bands is a few points. This is the smallest band-to-band gap the current sample could have called real.

clustering.note: Interval width scales with the standard error and sample size with variance, so a 1.48x width penalty means roughly 2.2x the games are needed for the same resolution. Every MDE below carries this.
